decisions.initial_strategy: Demand return of confidential materials immediately and seek injunctive relief to prevent disclosure.
decisions.forum: State court where the consultant resides or where the alleged breach occurred.
decisions.requested_relief: Return of all confidential product roadmaps and injunctive relief to prevent further disclosure.
decisions.employment_restriction: Request non-disclosure and non-solicitation covenants as part of any settlement agreement.

commitments.detail: Prevent the consultant from disclosing the confidential product roadmaps.
